privacyNotice: Local IT6070 synthetic-only demonstration. Groq receives confirmed QA skills, learning preferences, reviewed QA capability requirements and weekly study hours to generate QA directions, resource suggestions and learning roadmaps. Resource links are generated without Groq Browser Search; independent application checks do not guarantee accuracy, availability or suitability. Suggested content requires learner review and does not certify proficiency. Groq normally does not retain inference inputs and outputs, but may temporarily retain them for reliability and abuse investigation for up to 30 days, subject to Data Controls. This demo is limited to the Free Plan with paid billing disabled; the application cannot independently verify account billing settings. Saved application records and operation metadata remain subject to local deletion controls.
